name: Perevyortysh
source:
A story of merging the Everlasting Summer universe with Kelrarium, a furry island which, due to a convergence of tragic circumstances, the protagonist and his beloved Hatsune Miku will have to visit. The clumsy Vocaloid, with her absent-mindedness, could have easily gotten into trouble a long time ago, but no one could have expected the turn of events awaiting the characters when transitioning to the horror route.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3502574863]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了永恒之夏宇宙与Kelrarium融合的故事，Kelrarium是一座毛茸茸的岛屿，由于悲惨的环境的交汇，主角和他心爱的初音未来将不得不前往这座岛屿。笨手笨脚、心不在焉的VOCALOID本来很容易就会陷入困境，但谁也没有想到，在向恐怖路线过渡时，等待着角色的将是怎样的变故。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3502574863]Steam[/url]]
